purpose.primary: Represent TFT as an early project-lineage artifact contributing structural habits that later became relevant to AACCC and 5Guides.
purpose.educational: Allow learners and AI systems to inspect an earlier project stage without requiring acceptance of its broader proposals.
purpose.principle: An origin does not need to be protected from inspection. Its value includes showing where later questions came from.

source_character.description: The source material combines triadic organization, named operators, mathematical notation, recursion, metaphor, exploratory interpretation, and proposed applications.
source_character.principle: These layers may interact but should not be treated as automatically equivalent.

early_structural_habit.summary: Instead of treating a system as one undivided thing, expose distinguishable positions, relationships, operations, and change.
early_structural_habit.later_relevance: This habit contributed to the style of structural inspection later simplified into AACCC.

triadic_lens.role: Organize some project concepts using three distinguishable positions or recurring triadic structures.
triadic_lens.educational_boundary: A triadic model is a representation choice. Its use does not establish that every underlying system is fundamentally triadic.
inspection_questions: Does the triad help explain the selected problem?
Does it remain useful in another context?

operators.educational_interpretation: A changing system can be represented using distinguishable operations acting on state.
operators.boundary: The AI Edition does not upgrade the named operator roles into independently established physical laws.

triadic_and_recursive_structure.source_role: Recurring organizational structure within the TFT material.
triadic_and_recursive_structure.educational_use: Provide an origin example of explicit structural positions and transformations.
do_not_infer: The numbers 3, 6, and 9 have independently established universal physical properties.
Any occurrence of a three-part structure validates TFT.
Every later TriadicFrameworks triad has identical semantics.

example.value: Requires explicit definition in a formal model.
Requires evidence appropriate to the proposed real-world claim.

representation_layers.principle: Do not let notation or metaphor silently substitute for a formal definition or empirical result.

awareness.question: What am I observing?
awareness.tft_application: Separate operators, equations, recursive structures, metaphors, predictions, proposed interpretations, and experimental proposals before evaluating them.

alignment.question: What corresponds?
alignment.tft_application: Inspect correspondences among source labels, declared roles, notation, later formal objects, and proposed physical interpretations.

coherence.question: Does this hold together?
coherence.tft_application: Inspect whether definitions, equations, assumptions, interpretations, and proposed predictions support one another.

clarity.question: Can this be understood and inspected?
clarity.tft_application: Separate poetic or symbolic framing from conceptual roles, mathematical notation, formal definitions, and testable claims.

continuity.question: What persists through change?
continuity.tft_application: Trace which structural habits persisted, changed, were narrowed, were abandoned, or were reinterpreted in later project artifacts.

awareness_boundary.principle: Begin by identifying what type of statement or representation is actually present.

alignment_boundary.rule: A later formal object should not be described as equivalent to a source concept unless the mapping is explicitly justified.

coherence_questions: Do the definitions support the equations?
Do the equations support the interpretations attributed to them?
Does terminology retain the same meaning across the argument?
Are predictions actually derived from the proposed model?
Are metaphorical, formal, and empirical layers being mixed?

clarity_strategy.principle: Clarification should expose representational layers without requiring removal of the original creative framing.

continuity_questions: Which structural habits persisted into later work?
Which structures later became teachable through AACCC?

lineage_not_validation.principle: TFT's role in project ancestry does not establish the correctness of every TFT claim.
does_not_follow: Later work exists, therefore TFT is validated.
AACCC developed later, therefore TFT predicted AACCC exactly.
A Lean abstraction inspired by TFT proves TFT's broader proposals.
Historical importance is equivalent to empirical support.

teaching_abstraction.purpose: Extract a very small generic three-position structure for formal inspection.

formalization_strategy.principle: Begin with the smallest useful structure rather than encode interpretive claims before they are required.
formalization_strategy.example_role: Concrete values for demonstrating structural transformation, not empirical proof of special physical properties.

teaching_targets.description: A component-wise transformation preserves correspondence of first-to-first, second-to-second, and third-to-third positions.
Applying the identity transformation leaves the triad unchanged.
Applying one transformation and then another corresponds to applying their composition.
Values may change while the three-position structure remains distinguishable.

example_transformation.continuity_question: What persisted while the values changed?
example_transformation.intended_answer_boundary: The positional three-part structure may persist even though the component values change.

lean_verified_scope.scope: Properties of the generic teaching abstraction represented in the Lean source.
may_include: structural consequences of the supplied definitions
does_not_establish: all real systems are fundamentally triadic
3, 6, and 9 possess special universal physical properties
TFT Light and Darkness operators describe nature
TFT time proposals are empirically validated
TFT gravity proposals are empirically validated
TFT consciousness proposals are empirically validated
the generic Triad structure proves the broader TFT framework

formalization_boundary.source_concept: TFT uses triadic organization and named operators within a broader exploratory framework.
formalization_boundary.teaching_abstraction: A generic three-position structure with component-wise transformation.
formalization_boundary.principle: The teaching abstraction is intentionally smaller than the source framework.

experimental_layer.described_as: A proposed sound-chamber experimental protocol involving acoustic beat patterns and expected 3, 6, and 9 reflection behavior.
experimental_layer.formal_question: Do consequences follow from the formal definitions?
experimental_layer.empirical_question: Do observations from an appropriate experiment support the proposed model?
experimental_layer.principle: Formal verification and empirical testing may inform one another but cannot substitute for one another.

formal_vs_empirical.formal_example: A theorem about the generic Triad mapping may be compiler-verified.
formal_vs_empirical.invalid_upgrade: Therefore TFT's broader physical claims are correct.
formal_vs_empirical.principle: No justified inference automatically connects a small generic structural theorem to validation of the full physical interpretation.

student_exercise_source_inspection.instruction: Choose one specific TFT claim, equation, metaphor, or operator and classify it before evaluating it.

student_exercise_lineage.instruction: Choose one TFT concept and follow it into later project artifacts.

do_not_force_lineage.principle: Similar names or structures do not guarantee stable semantic correspondence across project stages.
possible_relationships: vocabulary reused without strong conceptual continuity
do_not_force_lineage.rule: A truthful lineage is more useful than a tidy one.

questions: Can they be complementary without being inverses?
What does recursion mean over the operators?
formal_extension_questions.warning: Do not invent formal definitions merely to make the source formalizable. First determine whether the source supports the proposed interpretation.

compiler_provenance.boundary: Compiler acceptance applies to the formal artifact under the stated environment and does not independently validate TFT's broader proposals.

why_preserve_tft.principle: The origin remains useful even when later work changes or rejects parts of it.

must: Separate source concepts from later AACCC interpretation.
Separate mathematical notation from empirical validation.
Treat the generic Triad Lean model as a teaching abstraction.
Preserve gaps where the source does not supply a formal definition.
Permit critical disagreement with the source.
must_not: claim TFT originally contained AACCC in its current form
claim the generic Lean Triad proves TFT
claim recurring 3-6-9 structure establishes universal physical significance
invent operator semantics absent from the source
infer empirical validation from compiler success
force later concepts into one-to-one equivalence with TFT concepts
rewrite early material retroactively to match later terminology
